# Profiles IModule Mocks

This directory contains auto-generated mocks for the profiles module's repository interfaces.

##  Important: DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

All files in this directory are **auto-generated by mockery**. Any manual changes will be overwritten.

## Generating Mocks

### Regenerate Profiles Mocks Only

```bash
make mocks-profiles
```

### Regenerate All Mocks

```bash
make mocks
```

## Available Mocks

- `MockUserProfileRepository` - For user profile management
- `MockUserContactRepository` - For user contact information management

## Usage in Tests

```go
import (
    "github.com/basilex/promenade/internal/modules/profiles/repository/mocks"
)

func TestProfileUseCase_CreateProfile(t *testing.T) {
    // Create mock
    mockRepo := new(mocks.MockUserProfileRepository)

    // Set expectations
    mockRepo.On("Create", mock.Anything, mock.AnythingOfType("*entity.UserProfile")).Return(nil)

    // Use in test...
    mockRepo.AssertExpectations(t)
}
```

## When to Regenerate

Run `make mocks-profiles` after:

- Adding new methods to repository interfaces
- Changing method signatures
- Modifying return types
